Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #398 (the docs family of the 2026-10-26 repository review) as item 2 of 5. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `cdd4eea9`; the card's own analysis is not restated):

- One reading sharper than the card: `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` names `v17-docs-sweep` 7 times, not 4 — PR 2 (fingerprint relocation + `--self-test`) is the gating half; the docs PR must not delete the sweep file before it lands (`Blocked-by:` between the two, or one PR in that order).
- Why it is on the floor: deleting documents is 卡的命运 (triage human floor), and the card is honest that history stays in git. #25919 A 「存量不横扫」 governs source comments, not these planning files, as the card says.
- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **A** (delete, fix links and the script's source, ARCHITECTURE → pointer, root CHANGELOG → history + pointer, RELEASE_NOTES frozen, audits lifecycle line). Not B (a museum wing the link checkers must be taught to skip). Workload: devx · 2 PRs, no governed path.
Prior rulings read: `v17-docs-sweep` · `upgrading-to-11` · `v5-project-to-environment-rename` → the script's 7 reads, the SDK page link, the absent changeset; ADR none; thread: this card's triage comment.

Ruling: batch #398 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-10-26T13:38Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #398 with 「其他同意」 — every seat letter on the four cards other than #26073, whose letter is still open. Brief 6417225185. Letter **A**: delete the obsolete planning documents and plans (`docs/NEXT_STEP.md`, `DX_ROADMAP.md`, `PLUGIN_ECOSYSTEM_MAP.md`, `upgrading-to-11.md`, `v17-docs-sweep.md`, `launch-readiness.md`, `docs/plans/m1-…`, `docs/plans/release-15.1-…`), fix every inbound link (including the published `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:580`), relocate the fingerprints `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` reads from `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md` (7 reads on `origin/main`) into the script or a `scripts/data/` file with its `--self-test` extended, `ARCHITECTURE.md` → a pointer to the published architecture page, root `CHANGELOG.md` → history plus a pointer to `content/docs/releases/`, `RELEASE_NOTES.md` frozen, one audits lifecycle line in `docs/audits/README.md` and the closed 2026-06 series archived; the dangling `.changeset/v5-project-to-environment-rename.md` references go. History stays in git. Not B (a museum wing the link checkers must skip) and not C (banners that grep does not read).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): devx · 2 PRs — PR 1 the script relocation with self-test (lands first), PR 2 docs-only with `Blocked-by:` PR 1's card or the same PR in that order; no governed path (`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` untouched).

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:docs` as triage graded, p2); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the dev greps README and the docs site for inbound links to `launch-readiness.md` / `ARCHITECTURE.md` before deleting (the card's confidence gap).
